headline: Mooring County Widens Colonial Hold; Linn Mercy Line Shifts Again
war_summary: The lines at Mooring County have shifted once more since this office's last edition. That district, six Colonial works to five Warden at the earlier filing, now stands eight Colonial to four, with no ruin between them; it remains the war's busiest ground, fifty-five actions in the past day, sixteen in six hours and three in the last two, and its twenty-four-hour casualty toll is the heaviest reported this hour. Linn Mercy, ten Colonial works and a ruin last edition, now reads nine Colonial, one Warden and one ruin, with five actions in the last two hours. Weathered Expanse has gone quieter: its Colonial holdings slipped from four to three as unclaimed ruins rose from one to four, and no fresh action has been logged in two hours. Callum's Cape, now five Colonial works to two Warden, recorded one action in two hours after five in six. Marban Hollow holds four Warden works to three Colonial with one ruin and a single action in six hours. Elsewhere the map is largely still: Dead Lands, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle report heavy accumulated losses but no ownership changes in the past day.
